resources.string: Wellness estimates from your shared OmniGart profile

OmniGart provides wellness estimates only. Readiness, stress, HRV, Baevsky index, body-fat estimates, hydration targets, and training plans are not medical advice. Consult a qualified professional for health concerns.
Not medical advice. Consult a professional.
Stop and seek emergency help if you feel chest pain, severe dizziness, or unusual shortness of breath during activity.
Figures such as readiness, stress, HRV, Baevsky index, body fat, and hydration are wellness estimates based on your inputs and device samples. Plans are coaching suggestions, not prescriptions.

OmniGart can read and write wellness samples (heart rate, HRV, sleep, workouts, body mass, hydration) to improve on-device estimates. Data is not used for ads or sent to unrelated third parties. You can continue without granting access.
Connect a heart-rate or similar fitness accessory for live samples. OmniGart works fully without Bluetooth.
The camera is used only to scan food barcodes. You can log food manually if you deny access.
Optional reminders for workouts, hydration, and morning wellness check-ins. The app stays usable with notifications off.

OmniGart requests Health Connect access to read and write fitness and wellness data you choose — such as heart rate, HRV, sleep, workouts, body mass, and hydration — so readiness and training estimates stay accurate on your device.\n\nWe do not sell health data, use it for advertising, or share it with third parties for marketing. You can deny access and keep using OmniGart with manual entry.
Choose how OmniGart estimates wellness figures such as energy use, heart-rate zones, body fat, and strength.
Log strength sets for wellness training estimates. Figures are coaching aids, not medical advice.
